params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; Write-Output '=== runner processes ==='; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'Runner\.(Listener|Worker)' -or $_.CommandLine -match 'actions-runner|Runner.Listener|Runner.Worker' } | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine | Format-List; Write-Output '=== likely runner dirs ==='; $roots=@('C:\HeavenServices','C:\Users\Xxkan','C:\actions-runner','C:\github-runner'); foreach($root in $roots){ if(Test-Path $root){ Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Directory -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'runner|actions|github' } | Select-Object FullName,Name,LastWriteTimeUtc } }; Write-Output '=== exact runner files under bounded roots ==='; foreach($root in @('C:\HeavenServices','C:\Users\Xxkan')){ if(Test-Path $root){ Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Recurse -File -Filter 'Runner.Listener.exe' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 20 FullName,Length,LastWriteTimeUtc } }; Write-Output '=== services ==='; Get-CimInstance Win32_Service | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'actions|runner|github' -or $_.DisplayName -match 'actions|runner|github' -or $_.PathName -match 'Runner.Listener|actions-runner' } | Select-Object Name,DisplayName,State,StartMode,PathName | Format-List; Write-Output '=== scheduled tasks ==='; Get-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.TaskName -match 'actions|runner|github' -or $_.TaskPath -match 'actions|runner|github' } | Select-Object TaskName,TaskPath,State | Format-Table -AutoSize
